arabic_html:
وَمَن يَعْمَلْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهُۥ ثُمَّ
يَسْتَغْفِرِ ٱللَّهَ يَجِدِ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا ۞
translation: And whoever does a wrong or wrongs himself but then seeks forgiveness of Allah will find Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr, from Ibn ʿAbbās: Allah is telling His servants about His forgiveness and expansive mercy. Whoever sins — small or great — and then turns back, finds Him already forgiving.
